areas.title: Areas (state codes)
areas.description: Limit to these US states or territories, as two-letter codes ("CA", "HI", "AK") or names ("California"). Leave empty to check all coastal areas nationwide.

severities.title: Alert types
severities.description: Limit to these alert types: "Tsunami Warning", "Tsunami Watch", "Tsunami Advisory" (any capitalisation; "warning", "watch" and "advisory" work too). Leave empty to check all three.
